results.content:
Netflix was the main reason I was able to cut the cable TV cord way back in 2008, and since then it’s been our home’s streaming staple. Even as we cycled through other services, Netflix was worth keeping because it usually had something we wanted to watch. [...] No matter what happens next, I’ve realized that Netflix’s place in our home is no longer untouchable. There are too many other options, all becoming increasingly expensive, with only finite time to watch what they’re offering. If Netflix is going to become a staple again, it’ll have to earn its place like any other streaming service.

Sign up for Jared’s Cord Cutter Weekly newsletter for more streaming TV advice.

Jared Newman
